skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is a research surface owned by other batches; the one ledger correction this reading supports is proposed through the intake note rather than edited.
A patient genotype-phenotype report supplies no therapeutic lever for the reference genotype class; forging hypotheses from one case would manufacture a lead.
No compound is tested as an intervention with a measured outcome beyond clinical anecdote, so there is no molecule to send to BLOCK-1 triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate for a later BATCH_COMMIT.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader of a paper cannot audit their own locators.

group_assessment.weighting: PubMed counts 2026-10-02: Li ZM[au] AND Zhongshan 20; Li ZM[au] AND WWOX 1. A prenatal-diagnosis laboratory; the structural-variant work (WGS + gap-PCR + Sanger junctions) is the strength, the clinical description is thin and partly borrowed in wording.

entries.proposition: Exome CNV calling reported a homozygous exon 6 deletion.
entries.snippet: The WES analysis revealed a homozygous deletion involving exon 6 of the WWOX gene in the proband.

entries.proposition: Genome sequencing assigns the intron-5 deletion a size of about 13.3 kb.
entries.snippet: Another deletion about 13,261 bp in length involved intron 5

entries.proposition: The inheritance sentence swaps the sizes of the two deletions on the two-deletion allele, relative to the coordinates and to the preceding paragraph.
entries.snippet: the discontinuous deletion of intron 5(53,904 bp) and exon 6(13,260 bp)

entries.proposition: The consequence of the in-frame exons 6-8 deletion is theoretical (predicted), not measured.
entries.snippet: theoretically produces a protein with normal WW domains, but due to the disruption of the SDR domain, it may retain poor residual function

entries.proposition: The exon 6 deletion's frameshift consequence is predicted.
entries.snippet: is a common deletion predicted to cause a frameshift mutation resulting in a truncated protein with loss of function

entries.proposition: Only two antiseizure drugs are named.
entries.snippet: The administration of antiepileptic drugs (sodium valproate and topiramate tablet) was not effective.

entries.proposition: The 'earliest onset' claim is made for day-15 onset; day-1 onsets are already published.
entries.snippet: Our proband had the earliest onset of epilepsy, presenting on the 15th day of life.

entries.proposition: This clause is word-for-word the clause Riva 2022 writes about its own patient.
entries.snippet: his multidaily tonic seizures never responded to any pharmacological treatment
He died at the age of two and a half years because of persistent seizures.
